caption:
Squash or badminton after work? Those deep lunges and quick pivots ask a lot of your knees and ankles 🏸

Both sports pack hundreds of lunges, stops and push-offs into one match, often in a small space. Calves, knees and ankles take most of that load.

Hybi's prep: split squats, step-ups and slow single-leg calf raises twice a week. Before you play, warm up with lunges in each direction and side shuffles, then ease into the first game.

A sudden pop at the back of the heel, a knee that swells or locks, or an ankle you can't stand on is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
